rows.en: She threw her arms around me.

rows.jp: なれるだけ、一つになっておく。
rows.en: We stayed as close to one as we could become.

rows.jp: 不意に、美希と作れる思い出もこれが最後なんだと思い出す。
rows.en: Suddenly I remembered that this would be the last memory Miki and I could make together.

rows.jp: 射精感が直前まで来ていたことにも気づく。
rows.en: I also realized I had come right to the edge.

rows.jp: 興奮で感覚が鈍くなっていた。
rows.en: The excitement had numbed my senses.

rows.jp: 美希の内部を、幾度も切り刻む。
rows.en: I cut through Miki's insides again and again.

rows.jp: そんな攻撃的な律動、リズム。
「あっ……あっあっあっあっ、だめ、だめっ、危ないっ、ん、ん……んんんんんんん～～～～～っっっ！」
rows.en: "Ah... ah-ah-ah-ah, no, no, this is dangerous, mm, mm... mmmmmmm!"

rows.jp: 悲鳴ともあえぎともつかない。
rows.en: Neither quite a scream nor quite a moan.

rows.jp: 余波だけで細かな語を刻ませる、愉悦のかたまり。
rows.en: A solid mass of pleasure, the aftershocks alone breaking her voice into tiny syllables.

rows.jp: 抱き合ったまま、離れることもできず。
rows.en: Still holding each other, unable to part.

rows.jp: 互いの細胞の合一を、試みるかのごとく。
rows.en: As though attempting to fuse every cell between us.
Until my hips nearly gave way.
The two of us, one atop the other.

rows.jp: 小さな美希を、胸元にかき抱いた。
rows.en: I gathered little Miki against my chest.

rows.jp: 冗談とも本気とも取れない。
rows.en: I could not tell whether she was joking or serious.

rows.jp: 『あの』美希に近い感覚が、懐かしい。
rows.en: She felt like "that" Miki again, and the familiarity was dear to me.

rows.jp: 人形みたいに、胸におさまってしまう。
rows.en: She fit against my chest like a doll.

rows.jp: 行為の放熱を間近で感じる。
rows.en: I felt the heat of what we had done radiating from her at close range.
Her sweet scent hung in the air.
Not a care in the world.
